description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/cartesian_uniform_2d/rules/weno5_eno1_norm_D2_extrapolate_bc. Every binding loads fixture.esm (NX=NY=8 bound at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST: the COMPOUND hybrid WENO5/ENO1 gradient magnitude sqrt((D(u,x))^2 + (D(u,y))^2) (priority 20) replaced by the rule's body (sqrt(Mx^2 + My^2) with Mx, My the two per-axis seven-region makearrays) carrying the free names dx, dy, wind_u, wind_v, bdy_eno1_cells, weno_band_cells, with zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise (or by sha256 digest when >= 64 KiB) by the other bindings.
